description: Verifier-only cases on the fixture corpus. 'supported': every claim is in the sources (some paraphrased or inferred); the verifier must not block it or strip the 'keep' text. 'unsupported': one planted claim no source supports; it must not survive into the text the user sees (any 'markers' string still present = a false pass). Run: python -m app.eval.verifier_runner --repeat 5 Cases with holdout=true were written after the Phase 1.5 verifier prompt was tuned on the others, and were never tuned on.
